title: Crunchyroll Streams English Dub for 'The Prince of Tennis: Two Samurais, The First Game,' The Prince of Tennis: A Gift from Atobe Films
content: Crunchyroll has added the English dub version for The Prince of Tennis: Two Samurais, The First Game ( Tennis no Oujisama: Futari no Samurai The First Game ) and The Prince of Tennis: A Gift from Atobe ( Tennis no Oujisama: Atobe Kara no Okurimono ) films on October 15.

title: Seven Seas Licenses Sagrada Reset Novel; Two Cats and a Dog, The Mercenary Bomber Explodes All Cheaters Manga
content: Seven Seas announced the following manga, light novel, and audiobook licenses on Wednesday: These so-called heroes? Japanese high schoolers summoned en masse, granted cheat-level powers, and now plunging the world into chaos.

title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime Reveals 4 Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga announced four more cast members for the anime on Thursday. The four cast members voice the royal family of the Country of Long Nights.
author: ANN

title: BanG Dream! Releases Ave Mujica prima aurora Movie Commercial Featuring "Baddy Baddy"
content: BanG Dream! released a 30-second commercial for the Ave Mujica prima aurora anime movie that features one of the band’s newest songs, “Baddy Baddy.” The song is also part of their latest mini-album , released on October 21. The movie is currently screening in Japanese theaters. Also check out: BanG Dream!

title: Live-Action My Sister's Boyfriend Film's Trailer Unveils Song by timelesz
content: The official website for My Sister's Boyfriend, the live-action film of Amu Meguro 's Midori Loves My Sister ( Onē-chan no Midori-kun or literally My sister's Midori-kun ) manga, presented a new 60-second trailer and character posters for the film on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Cygames to Reimburse Travel, Lodging for Canceled Uma Musume Concerts
content: Cygames announced on Wednesday that it is preparing to reimburse the travel and lodging expenses of those who were planning to attend the now-canceled Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage concerts in Los Angeles.
author: ANN

title: 27 Years Ago, This Legendary Shonen Anime First Aired, and It’s Still Dominating the Industry
content: Shonen anime tend to run for a long time, as has been the pattern for decades. However, no anime is bigger than the one that first aired 27 years ago and shows no signs of stopping.

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime of 2026 Also Has the Most Tragic Hero of the Year
content: 2026 has been an exceptional year for dark anime airing on Crunchyroll , with several series premiering since the start of the year. However, Fall 2026 has brought another dark anime that stands out even among the darkest, with a protagonist whose journey is built on a tragic childhood.
